recognize_zh: 中倍下擴張的淋巴竇中聚集大量淡粉紅色、細胞質豐富的大型組織球，其中數顆可見包含多個淋巴球（emperipolesis），周邊為富含漿細胞與淋巴球的深染條索，符合 Rosai-Dorfman 病。
features: Dilated sinuses packed with large histiocytes having abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Several histiocytes contain multiple intact lymphocytes (emperipolesis)
Intervening dense cords of small lymphocytes and plasma cells
Sinus-predominant distribution with preserved lymphoid cords
describe_en: Lymph node section (H&E) at intermediate power shows sinuses distended by clusters of large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and round vesicular nuclei. Several histiocytes contain multiple intact lymphocytes within their cytoplasm, indicating emperipolesis. The intervening cords are rich in small lymphocytes and plasma cells. Findings are consistent with Rosai-Dorfman disease; the histiocytes are expected to be S100 and CD68 positive and CD1a negative.

ddx.vs: LCH cells have grooved nuclei with eosinophils and express CD1a/langerin, without prominent emperipolesis.
Reactive histiocytes are smaller, S100 negative and lack conspicuous emperipolesis.
HLH histiocytes ingest and degrade erythrocytes and nucleated cells rather than harboring intact lymphocytes in clear vacuoles.
Carcinoma forms cohesive atypical epithelial clusters that are keratin positive.
